record.question: A person can plough a field in 25 days. In how many days will 15 people be able to complete the job?
record.explanation: Defective as printed: the PDF (page 8, Q88, verified visually) reads exactly 'A person can plough a field in 25 days. In how many days will 15 people be able to complete the job?' with options 11, 14, 15, 18. The job is 25 person-days, so 15 people together finish in 25/15 = 5/3 ≈ 1.67 days, which is not among the options; no faithful reading of the printed stem (e.g. 15 people ploughing 15 fields = 25 days) yields any listed value, and the shared direction gives no repair. Held for reviewer; missing evidence is an uncorrupted stem or an official key.
